# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import airflow
from airflow import DAG
from airflow.models import Variable
from airflow.sensors.external_task import ExternalTaskSensor
from airflow.sensors.sql_sensor import SqlSensor
from airflow.operators.bash_operator import BashOperator
from airflow.operators.python_operator import BranchPythonOperator
from airflow.operators.dagrun_operator import TriggerDagRunOperator
from airflow.operators.dummy_operator import DummyOperator
from airflow.api.common.experimental.pool import get_pool, create_pool
from airflow.exceptions import PoolNotFound
from airflow.models import BaseOperator
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
import pendulum

try:
    Email_receiver = Variable.get("Email_receiver")
except KeyError:
    Email_receiver = "not-set@domain.com"


class CreatePoolOperator(BaseOperator):
    ui_color = '#b8e9ee'

    def __init__(
            self,
            name,
            slots,
            description='',
            *args, **kwargs):
        super(CreatePoolOperator, self).__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self.description = description
        self.slots = slots
        self.name = name

    def execute(self, context):
        try:
            pool = get_pool(name=self.name)
            print('Pool exists: %s'%(pool))
        except PoolNotFound:
            # create the pool
            pool = create_pool(name=self.name, slots=self.slots, description=self.description)
            print('Pool exists: %s'%(pool))


local_tz = pendulum.timezone("UTC")


default_args = {
    'owner': 'airflow',
    'depends_on_past': False,
    'start_date': datetime(2017, 1, 1, 0, 0, tzinfo=local_tz),
    'max_active_runs': 1,
    'email': Email_receiver,
    'email_on_failure': False,
    'email_on_retry': False,
    'retry_exponential_backoff': False,
    'retries': 0,
    'pool': 'DBImport_test',
    'retry_delay': timedelta(minutes=5),
}

dag = DAG(
    'DBImport_test',
    default_args=default_args,
    description='DBImport_test',
    catchup=False,
    schedule_interval=None)

start = BashOperator(
    task_id='start',
    bash_command='sudo -iu dbimport /usr/local/dbimport/bin/manage --checkAirflowExecution --airflowDAG=DBImport_test',
    priority_weight=100,
    weight_rule='absolute',
    pool=None,
    dag=dag)

stop = BashOperator(
    task_id='stop',
    bash_command='sudo -iu dbimport /usr/local/dbimport/bin/manage --sendAirflowStopMessage --airflowDAG=DBImport_test',
    priority_weight=100,
    weight_rule='absolute',
    pool=None,
    dag=dag)

before_tasks_finished = DummyOperator(
    task_id='before_tasks_finished',
    priority_weight=100,
    weight_rule='absolute',
    dag=dag)

main_tasks_finished = DummyOperator(
    task_id='main_tasks_finished',
    priority_weight=100,
    weight_rule='absolute',
    dag=dag)

events = BashOperator(
    task_id='events',
    bash_command='sudo -iu dbimport /usr/local/dbimport/bin/import -h testdb -t events  ',
    pool='DBImport_test',
    priority_weight=1,
    weight_rule='absolute',
    retries=5,
    dag=dag)

before_tasks_finished.set_downstream(events)
events.set_downstream(main_tasks_finished)

orders_clearStage = BashOperator(
    task_id='orders_clearStage',
    bash_command='sudo -iu dbimport /usr/local/dbimport/bin/manage --clearImportStage -h testdb -t orders ',
    pool='DBImport_server_source.example',
    priority_weight=1,
    weight_rule='absolute',
    retries=5,
    dag=dag)

orders = BashOperator(
    task_id='orders',
    bash_command='sudo -iu dbimport /usr/local/dbimport/bin/import -h testdb -t orders  ',
    pool='DBImport_test',
    priority_weight=1,
    weight_rule='absolute',
    retries=5,
    dag=dag)

before_tasks_finished.set_downstream(orders_clearStage)
orders_clearStage.set_downstream(orders)
orders.set_downstream(main_tasks_finished)

after_main_01 = TriggerDagRunOperator(
    task_id='after_main_01',
    trigger_dag_id='other_dag',
    priority_weight=100,
    weight_rule='absolute',
    dag=dag)

before_main_01 = BashOperator(
    task_id='before_main_01',
    retries=5,
    bash_command='/usr/bin/sleep 1 ',
    priority_weight=1,
    weight_rule='absolute',
    dag=dag)

in_main_01 = BashOperator(
    task_id='in_main_01',
    retries=5,
    bash_command='sudo -iu dbimport /usr/local/dbimport/bin/manage --runHiveQuery="select 1" ',
    priority_weight=1,
    weight_rule='absolute',
    dag=dag)

main_tasks_finished.set_downstream(after_main_01)
after_main_01.set_downstream(stop)

start.set_downstream(before_main_01)
before_main_01.set_downstream(before_tasks_finished)

in_main_01.set_upstream(orders)
in_main_01.set_downstream(main_tasks_finished)


createPool_DBImport_test = CreatePoolOperator(
    name='DBImport_test',
    slots=24,
    task_id='createPool_DBImport_test',
    retries=5,
    priority_weight=1,
    weight_rule='absolute',
    pool=None,
    dag=dag)

start.set_downstream(createPool_DBImport_test)
createPool_DBImport_test.set_downstream(before_tasks_finished)


createPool_DBImport_server_source_example = CreatePoolOperator(
    name='DBImport_server_source.example',
    slots=24,
    task_id='createPool_DBImport_server_source_example',
    retries=5,
    priority_weight=1,
    weight_rule='absolute',
    pool=None,
    dag=dag)

start.set_downstream(createPool_DBImport_server_source_example)
createPool_DBImport_server_source_example.set_downstream(before_tasks_finished)
